description.value: Renzullo Food Market is a family-owned Italian specialty grocer that has anchored Vancouver's Hastings-Sunrise neighbourhood for over 50 years, now run by one of the founding family's daughters. The shop stocks imported Italian provisions—cold cuts, olive oils, tomato pastes, and more—alongside house-made spaghetti sauce and meatballs, and serves made-to-order paninis and espresso at a community table. Reviewers consistently describe the atmosphere as warm and convivial, likening it to sitting on an Italian piazza.
